Decided 2026-10-05 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner) for credential-evidence#235. Question: the value after the ApiKey scheme in an Authorization header of an Elastic Cloud Enterprise API request is a credential whatever its shape? Options: require a documented prefix or width (Elastic states none), or leave the case a draft. Decision: flag the value after the ApiKey scheme, covered whole, no subtype inference. Reason: the provider page documents only the Authorization: ApiKey carrier, not the value format, so the expectation rests on project policy and is not a provider rule or a fact. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154).
